short_title: How many holes does a T-shirt have? 👕
seo_intro:
How many holes does a T-shirt have? Four, three or zero?
A T-shirt has four openings but only three holes: stretch it without tearing and it flattens into a shape with exactly three holes (in topology, holes = openings minus one).
tags: how many holes does a t-shirt have
how many holes in a t shirt
how many holes does a straw have
comment: Four, three or zero: what did you say? 👕 Tag the friend who said four 👇
answer: 2 — THREE holes. A T-shirt has 4 openings (collar, bottom, 2 sleeves). Stretch it without tearing: pull the bottom opening wide and flatten it, the collar and the 2 sleeves become 3 holes. For a one-piece tube-like object, holes = openings - 1 (straw 2-1 = 1, pants 3-1 = 2, T-shirt 4-1 = 3).
